argv:
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$base='http://127.0.0.1:17448'
Write-Output '=== MANAGED AGENT METADATA ==='
$s=Invoke-RestMethod -Uri ($base+'/api/supervisor-watchdog?detect=0') -TimeoutSec 12
$i=0
foreach($c in @($s.config.managedChats)){
 $i++
 $role=[string]$c.role
 $repo=[string]$c.repository
 $proj=[string]$c.projectId
 $branch=[string]$c.branch
 Write-Output ("AGENT_"+$i+" enabled="+$c.enabled+" role="+$role+" repo="+$repo+" branch="+$branch+" project="+$proj+" has_url="+[bool]$c.url)
}
Write-Output ('CONFIG_MANAGED_COUNT='+$i)
Write-Output '=== LOCATE CODE ROUTES ==='
$src='E:\WebAIBridge\app\server.js'
$patterns=@('function queueManagedAgentTask','function queueManagedAgentBatch','operator-lifecycle','settings/pause','settings/resume','queue/pause','queue/resume','agent-assignments/dry-run')
foreach($p in $patterns){
 $ms=@(Select-String -LiteralPath $src -SimpleMatch -Pattern $p | Select-Object -First 8)
 foreach($m in $ms){Write-Output ('CODE '+$m.LineNumber+' '+$m.Line.Trim().Substring(0,[Math]::Min(150,$m.Line.Trim().Length)))}
}
Write-Output '=== END ==='
